messages:
Ana M: :wave: Quick sync — we have an ML Infra SWE candidate scheduled for Wed 2026-05-12 10:00 PT. Current panel assigned: Kevin T (system design), Devon R (runtime/serving), Lina C (behavioral). Need one volunteer to cover system design if Kevin needs to move. Also need a scribe. Quick rubric question: should we weight infra/serving more than code? I'm proposing 50% infra, 30% system design, 20% culture. Thoughts? @interview-bot please try to lock a room.

Kevin T: I might need to shift to 1–2pm PT that day — got a customer sync. If that blocks, I can still join remotely for the system-design portion. Not ideal to be async.

Devon R: I can cover system design if Kevin swaps — I have a conflict during my current slot (deployment demo) but can flip.

Lina C: I'll coordinate with recruiting about the take-home status. Also we usually ask for a scribe — who's up for notes? I'll set up the debrief doc once people confirm.

Greg H: I can scribe. Quick rubric clarifying Qs: 1) Do we use 1–5 scoring per category? 2) Do we add a subscore for "serving ops" under infra? 3) What's the pass threshold?

Ana M: Yes, use 1–5 (1=insufficient, 5=exceptional). Add a "serving ops" subscore under infra (mark as required). Pass threshold: team default is avg >= 3.5 and no category below 2; we can raise if we want stricter bar.

Kevin T: Sounds good. One more ask — should we include a short whiteboard prompt specifically about KV/prefix caching and cache invalidation? That's relevant to the role (real-world serving).

Devon R: Strong yes on the KV/cache prompt. Also, emphasize latency/gradual degradation scenarios in the system-design prompt — we want to see operational trade-offs.

Lina C: I'll confirm the take-home with recruiting. If candidate hasn't submitted, we can still run the loop but mark take-home as "not-reviewed" and ask follow-up if needed. I'll create a doc and post link here.

interview-bot: Room booked: conf-3 for 2026-05-12 10:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to panel.

Ana M: Thanks :thumbsup:. Greg — I'll assign you as scribe in the debrief doc. Please fill the pre-brief checklist before the interview (candidate resume + any flagged areas). Rubric snippet for copy/paste: ```
categories: ["infra (serving ops)", "system design", "culture"]
weights: {"infra (serving ops)": 50, "system design": 30, "culture": 20}
scoring_scale: 1-5
pass_criteria: "average >= 3.5 and no category < 2"
notes: "mark red-flag items; add short examples for each score level"
```

Kevin T: Great, I'll try to keep my calendar flexible and will confirm swap by EOD.

Devon R: Confirmed swap with Kevin — I'll take system design at 10am PT. Kevin, lmk if remote still needed.

Lina C: Doc created and shared: https://docs.internal/redwood/interviews/mlinfra-debrief-4792009876 — added pre-brief checklist and rubric.

Greg H: Got it, I'll scribe and pre-fill candidate name/resume. Will also capture 3 takeaways and any red flags.

Ana M: Awesome, thanks everyone. Final reminder: please bring one concrete question about serving runtime/latency tradeoffs. If anything changes ping here.

Kevin T: Thanks — will do.

Devon R: see you then.
